changes: Added experiments/recovery-runner/run-driver.mjs — the §5/§6 powered-ablation RUN DRIVER (infra-(a) piece 4): enumerates the full pre-registered cell matrix (5 arms × tasks × {null-ablation + B1-B15} × k) honoring §3 applicability (B4/B5/B10 exclude A1), seeded reproducible order; canonicalizes each raw run into the EXACT §7 record by delegating to adjudicate.mjs + checks.mjs; stamps denominatorSets per the 4 §5 contrasts; §7 validity filter (infra-void→re-run+durable sidecar log, task-failure kept, exhausted→non-zero exit); §1 A2prime budget log; strict int CLI parse + dup arms/scenarios/tasks guards (host-2 hardening). Plus run-driver-selfcheck.mjs (135 offline assertions) + run-selfchecks.mjs aggregator wired into root npm test via test:experiments.
usage: node experiments/recovery-runner/run-driver.mjs --tasks <ids> --k 5 enumerates the matrix (writes the N/A exclusions sidecar; no engine ran). Supply --engine <module.mjs> exporting default async (cell,attempt)=>rawResult to run the campaign. Verify offline: node experiments/recovery-runner/run-driver-selfcheck.mjs (135 assertions) or npm run test:experiments.
expectedOutcome: Operator runs `node experiments/recovery-runner/run-driver-selfcheck.mjs` and sees labeled groups (enumeration / schema / adjudicate delegation / denominator-sets / validity-filter / seeded-order / budget-log / negative-control / CLI-integration) ending in `✓ run-driver-selfcheck: 135 assertions passed, 0 failed (no live LLM)` exit 0; `npm run test:experiments` runs all 4 recovery-runner selfchecks green; the no-engine CLI prints the applicable + N/A cell counts and refuses to launch a live campaign.
actualTranscript: node experiments/recovery-runner/run-driver-selfcheck.mjs => 135 assertions passed, 0 failed (no live LLM), exit 0. node experiments/recovery-runner/run-selfchecks.mjs => all 4 selfchecks pass (adjudicate 98 + checks 112 + spend-accounting 56 + run-driver 135). node run-driver.mjs --tasks eval-expr,median,parse-range,text-stats --k 5 => enumerated 1540 applicable cells; 12 N/A cells excluded (logged); refuses live campaign without --engine. Full npm test exit 0.
outcomeDiff: No difference — expected and actual match exactly (135/0 assertions, 4/4 selfchecks, 1540 cells/12 N/A, no-engine refusal all as expected).
limitations: Builds + self-tests the driver only; does NOT run the live multi-day powered campaign (separate task) — without --engine the CLI refuses to run live. The A2prime ±20% band COMPUTATION lives in run-ablation/spend-accounting (B-5bfe); the driver only surfaces the band result faithfully.
pitfalls: DONE merge was hard-won: the DONE pre-check auto-syncs an actively-advancing main, drifting whole-tree materialHash and staling the quorum/reviewer passes (storyFilesHash tolerance is advisory, not honored by the strict DONE floor). Recovery: wait for main to quiesce, re-bind 4 review lanes + host-2 via the HOST claude CLI (in-app subagent dispatch was 529-overloaded; codex rate-limited — use claude -p directly), quorum_submit with DISTINCT keyA/keyB/sessionA/sessionB (same-vendor 2-host needs distinct identity or rounds are invalid), then refresh_stale→TEST→delivery→done_required→DONE while main stays quiet. The B-5c79 dup-guard blocks re-submit at the same material — needs a genuine material change (we used the 4 host-2 LOW fixes). Kill stray node procs before done_required (50-proc pileup makes it die).
